in_hebrew.name: Blum
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Blum הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the German word ‘blumen’, meaning ‘flowers’. This name is of secular origin and is popularly used in the Western world as a feminine given name.

in_greek.name: Blum
in_greek.long_meaning: Blum είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the German word ‘blumen’, meaning ‘flowers’. This name is of secular origin and is popularly used in the Western world as a feminine given name.

in_latin.name: Blum
in_latin.long_meaning: Blum est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the German word ‘blumen’, meaning ‘flowers’. This name is of secular origin and is popularly used in the Western world as a feminine given name.
